name: Hotel Garni Austria
beschreibung: Hotel Garni Austria is centrally located in St. Johann in Tirol, close to the town's vibrant pedestrian area. The surrounding Kitzbühel Alps offer exceptional recreation, from scenic alpine hiking routes in summer to extensive ski slopes in winter. The hotel provides tastefully furnished rooms with alpine charm and a welcoming breakfast lounge serving a fresh morning buffet.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Garni Austria in central St. Johann in Tirol features comfortable bed-and-breakfast rooms, quick pedestrian access, and proximity to Kitzbühel Alps ski and hiking trails.
